_comment: Grimdark — a grim machined-console theme (clean armour-style plating, crisp lines). Aged-COPPER fittings over cool near-black plating; MATTE material = opaque grimdark slab but DIMENSIONAL (keeps shadows + top-lit gradients, unlike flat). Machined console: recessed instrument panels, domed bolt fittings, bolted plate-seam rails, corner gussets, copper edge-trim. Register presets (Legion/Ordos/Forge) are pack settings. Open/non-IP assets only. See docs/THEME_PACK.md.
_colors_note: Canonical palette: cool near-black slab + COOL BLUE-GREY WHITE body text (#E7E8EC) + aged-copper accent/trim. Bone (subtext1) is a RITUAL ACCENT only, not body text. Cyan (teal #57D8D2) = the one saturated note — reserved for active/live readouts. Balance: black dominant, copper a thin line, cyan a pinpoint.
_font_note: Display face = Cinzel SemiBold (OFL, shipped in fonts/) — inscriptional Roman caps, an engraved titling face. Body stays mono for legibility.

panels._steel_note: The frame's flat welded-steel family (FrameFx _faHi/_faMd/_faLo + recess), single-sourced here so popups/cards/buttons match the bezel. hi=top-lit, md=body, lo=lower, edge=recess/cut shadow, lip=lit machined lip.

_register_note: Sub-theme REGISTERS (adr_027): the pack ships one machined-console chassis re-liveried per faction. The base colours above ARE the Legion register; a register deep-merges its overrides on top (colours + panels.steel + accent-metal + live-edge). Selected via pack setting `register`; defaultRegister when unset. Copper/cyan (Legion) -> gold/crimson (Ordos) -> brass/toxic-green (Forge). NOTE: palettes are placeholder — the intent is a full per-faction re-livery (structure/motifs/type), not just recolour.
_fx_note: LEGION register (clean armour, crisp lines). Structure via a single copper edge-trim (bevel=peach) tracing the whole content edge — 'copper trim only on edges' — over a flat matte slab. NO noise texture, NO marching rivets, NO wire arches: those belong to future FORGE (wires/greebles) + ORDOS (ornament) sub-themes. Future: full per-faction re-livery, not just palette swap.
